name: Genpei War Ends Heian Aristocratic Rule
summary: The Genpei War between the Taira and Minamoto clans ended with the Battle of Dan-no-ura (1185) where the child Emperor Antoku drowned with the Taira fleet. Minamoto Yoritomo established the Kamakura Shogunate, Japan's first military government, ending court aristocratic dominance.
